name: Confidence Thresholding
tagline: Accept when max softmax probability exceeds a single global threshold tuned on calibration data to hit the target coverage quantile.
pseudocode:
1. score(x) = $\max_c p_c(x)$ (max softmax).
2. On calibration: compute scores; set $\tau = Q_{1-c^*}(\{\text{scores}\})$ where $c^*$ is the target coverage.
3. At test: accept iff $\max_c p_c(x) \ge \tau$.
4. Return accepted predictions.
diff_from_baseline: Geifman & El-Yaniv, 'Selective Classification for Deep Neural Networks' (NeurIPS 2017). Default selective-prediction baseline using max softmax probability.

name: Split-Conformal Abstention
tagline: Pick the threshold by the split-conformal $\lceil(n+1)(1-\alpha)\rceil$ rank of nonconformity scores, giving a finite-sample coverage guarantee.
pseudocode:
1. Compute nonconformity $s_i = 1 - \max_c p_c(x_i)$ on calibration data.
2. $\alpha = 1 - c^*$; $r = \mathrm{clip}(\lceil(n+1)(1-\alpha)\rceil-1, 0, n-1)$.
3. $\tau = 1 - \mathrm{sort}(s)[r]$.
4. At test: accept iff $\max_c p_c(x) \ge \tau$.
diff_from_baseline: Vovk et al., 'Algorithmic Learning in a Random World' (2005); Angelopoulos & Bates conformal-prediction tutorial (2023). Distribution-free coverage via the calibration-set rank threshold.

name: Group-wise Thresholding
tagline: Per-subgroup confidence threshold: each group gets its own quantile-based cutoff, equalizing within-group coverage.
pseudocode:
1. score(x) = $\max_c p_c(x)$.
2. On calibration, set global $\tau = Q_{1-c^*}(\text{all scores})$ (fallback).
3. For each group $g$: $\tau_g = Q_{1-c^*}(\text{scores in } g)$.
4. At test: accept iff $\mathrm{score}(x) \ge \tau_{g(x)}$ (else $\tau$).
diff_from_baseline: Standard subgroup-aware selective-prediction baseline (e.g., Jones et al., 'Selective Classification Can Magnify Disparities Across Groups', ICLR 2021). Per-group thresholds equalize coverage across subgroups.

name: Learned Deferral
tagline: Train a logistic-regression meta-model on confidence features to predict correctness; threshold the meta-model probability for acceptance.
pseudocode:
1. features $\phi(x) = $ confidence-feature stack (probs, group ids, optional $X$).
2. labels $y_i^* = \mathbf{1}[\arg\max_c p_c(x_i) = y_i]$ on calibration.
3. Fit StandardScaler + balanced LogisticRegression on $(\phi(x_i), y_i^*)$.
4. score(x) = meta_model.predict_proba($\phi(x)$)$_{,1}$.
5. $\tau = Q_{1-c^*}(\text{scores})$; accept iff score(x) $\ge \tau$.
diff_from_baseline: Madras et al., 'Predict Responsibly: Improving Fairness and Accuracy by Learning to Defer' (NeurIPS 2018). Classic learned-rejector baseline using a meta-classifier on calibration features.
